title: Canada appoints Bob Rae as chairperson of the International Development Research Centre
excerpt: The former ambassador to the United Nations will lead the board of the federal Crown corporation.
bodyHtml:
The Government of Canada announced on November 2, 2026, the appointment of the Honourable Bob Rae as the chairperson of the Board of Governors of the International Development Research Centre (IDRC). The appointment was made by the Honourable Randeep Sarai, Secretary of State (International Development).

The IDRC is a federal Crown corporation established in 1970 that reports to Parliament through the secretary of state (international development). The board consists of up to 14 members who provide strategic direction, stewardship, and oversight for the organization.

Mr. Rae previously served as Canada’s ambassador and permanent representative to the United Nations. The Board of Governors oversees the centre's investments in research within developing countries and its efforts to share knowledge with policy makers.
